name: Doing Good
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively engage in doing good as an expression of their faith and trust in God. Trusting in the Lord leads to a life marked by good deeds, which not only bless the doer but also glorify God before others. Christians are encouraged to persevere in well-doing, recognizing that God has prepared good works for them to walk in, especially caring for fellow believers. Ultimately, doing good reflects the love God showed through Christ and serves as a visible testimony of His transforming power.
